_comment: The FIGHT leg of the 3-path mage-consult parity (cisterns_fight/talk/scout precedent -- three SEPARATE scripts, not one combined 'door_chain_paths', matching that precedent exactly and justified the same way: each leg's route/assertions differ enough that a single script would need multiple fixture re-installs mid-run for no real coverage gain). This is the FLAGSHIP end-to-end script: it proves Erin's beat-1 flicker line live (door_chain_fight_start stands the player facing her, post_game pre-banked), then the FIGHT leg of the mage consult (Pisces sends the player to clear rift_vermin_leak in the inn), then the FULL beat-3 recovery (ruin trip -> ruin_guardian fight -> anchor_stone_pedestal opens -> Krshia's resonant_catalyst purchase), ending with BOTH quest beats complete. door_chain_talk/door_chain_scout (fixture-started PAST beat 1, door_chain_started pre-banked) cover the other two consult legs plus a partial slice of the recovery beat each (talk proves the pedestal's OR-gate opens WITHOUT fighting the guardian; scout proves the catalyst purchase again from a different angle) -- together the three scripts cover door_understood parity, the pedestal's contains_when OR-gate from both a FIGHT and a non-FIGHT producer, and the full quest completion, without triple-deriving the whole chain three times. Uses `teleport` for every inter-map hop (real navigation across inn/street/floodplains/ruin_surface is ALREADY proven live by inn_walkthrough/gate_district_walkthrough/tutorial_flow/ruin_walkthrough -- this script's subject is the consult-path/combat/container/purchase wiring, not pathing; the arc_flow/deep_descent precedent for teleporting past an already-proven stretch). Every teleport lands one cell short of its target, followed by a `move` INTO the target (sets facing even when blocked, wi_game.gd move_player's unconditional `player_facing = dir` before the blocked check) before interact.
